about.content:
ABOUT URAANLABS STUDIO

Built for Leaders Who Refuse to Compromise on Engineering Craft

UraanLabs is a multidisciplinary software, AI automation, and cybersecurity studio. We bridge the void between distinctive brand design, scalable distributed systems, intelligent autonomous workflows, and bank-grade security.

Book an Architecture Discovery Call → Explore Vision & Accreditations
PURPOSE & STRATEGIC HORIZON

Our Vision & Mission for Venture-Scale Impact

Setting an uncompromising engineering benchmark for how scalable platforms, autonomous AI workflows, and zero-trust defensive security are designed and deployed.

🔭
OUR VISION

The Global Benchmark for Resilient Tech

To establish UraanLabs as the world-class venture engineering studio where ambitious founders and enterprise leaders build resilient digital infrastructure, deploy production-grade AI, and defend critical operations against modern adversarial threats.

VELOCITY Autonomous Efficiency: AI automation systems engineered to eliminate operational drag and unlock 10x team leverage.
SOVEREIGNTY Zero-Trust Defensibility: Cryptographically sound, auditable architectures where client data and core IP remain 100% sovereign.
SCALE Global Execution: Engineering solutions designed to power high-growth ventures across the US, UK, UAE, Saudi Arabia, and Australia.
🎯
OUR MISSION

Eradicating Broken Agencies & Fragile Code

To eliminate the fragmentation, technical debt, and bloated overhead of traditional agencies by placing multidisciplinary senior software architects, AI engineers, and security researchers directly at the table with client leadership from day zero.

SENIOR CRAFT Zero Middlemen: Direct architectural collaboration with senior craftspeople—eliminating account manager telephone loops.
INTEGRITY Production Reliability: Strict rejection of brittle shortcuts, untested AI wrappers, and vulnerable boilerplate code.
OWNERSHIP Absolute Client Control: 100% IP ownership, transparent Git history, clean Docker containers, and complete architectural documentation.
OUR STORY & ORIGIN

Why UraanLabs Was Built

In Urdu, the word "Uraan" embodies flight, ascent, and fearless upward momentum. We founded UraanLabs because the traditional agency landscape is broken by fragmentation.

When a growing company wants to build a modern software asset, they are typically forced to hire four disconnected vendors: a creative design agency that doesn't understand distributed databases, a low-cost dev shop that builds clunky interfaces and fragile code, a hype-driven AI freelancer who exposes private credentials to public models, and a legacy penetration testing auditor who only hands over a confusing PDF checklist without writing code.

The result is technical debt, finger-pointing, and bloated timelines. UraanLabs replaces that fragmentation with a single, highly integrated engineering studio where senior systems architects, AI engineers, product designers, and security researchers sit together from day zero.

100% In-House Senior Engineers & Designers
0 Account Executive "Telephone" Layers
2-4 Wk Focused Milestone Delivery Cycles
100% Client IP & Code Ownership
VERIFIED ENGINEERING CREDIBILITY

Security Accreditations & Compliance Standards

Every application, cloud deployment, and AI workflow we engineer is built to withstand rigorous enterprise compliance audits and adversary penetration tests.

INFORMATION SECURITY Audit-Ready

ISO/IEC 27001 Preparedness

ISMS governance framework, access control policies, and cryptographic key management designed to satisfy enterprise procurement security assessments.

STANDARD ISO/IEC 27001:2022
TRUST SERVICES SOC2 Aligned

SOC 2 Type II Architecture

Implementation of automated audit trails, encrypted data replication, role-based access control (RBAC), and SLA-backed uptime monitoring for cloud platforms.

FRAMEWORK AICPA Trust Criteria
DEFENSIVE DEVSECOPS Level 2+ Hardened

OWASP Top 10 & ASVS 4.0

Automated continuous SAST/DAST scanning, input sanitization, CSRF tokens, secure cookie flags, and SQL injection immunization across all API endpoints.

STANDARD OWASP ASVS v4.0
CLOUD GOVERNANCE Multi-Cloud Verified

AWS Well-Architected Framework

Zero-trust VPC subnets, AWS KMS envelope encryption, least-privilege IAM policies, and auto-scaling container clusters managed via Docker and Terraform.

PILLAR AWS Security & Ops
THREAT RESILIENCE NIST Aligned

NIST Cybersecurity Framework

Systematic operational alignment with the 6 core NIST CSF 2.0 functions: Govern, Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, and Recover across corporate assets.

GUIDELINE NIST SP 800-53 / CSF 2.0
DATA PRIVACY Zero-Retention

GDPR, HIPAA & AI Data Privacy

Zero Data Retention contracts with commercial LLM providers, localized VPC vector databases, pseudonymized audit records, and end-to-end data encryption.

REGULATION EU GDPR / US HIPAA
CORE DIFFERENTIATORS

How We Build Trust Without Fluff

We don't hide behind stock client logos or generic buzzwords. Our reputation is built on transparent code architecture, uncompromising security standards, and measurable velocity.

🛡

Security-by-Design, Not an Afterthought

Every backend route, cloud container, and database schema is subjected to rigorous OWASP Top 10 hardening, input sanitation, and simulated penetration testing before reaching staging. We build software ready for SOC2, ISO27001, and GDPR compliance audits on day one.

⚡

Production AI & Deterministic Automations

We avoid fragile no-code rigs. Our AI systems utilize structured schema validation, private RAG vector pipelines, and deterministic fallback logic so your business processes never fail from model hallucinations or API rate limits.

🔍

Direct Senior Engineering Access

You communicate directly with the software architects and product designers building your application via Slack or Discord. Zero middle-management account executives playing telephone with your technical requirements.

🚀

Rapid 4-Week Milestone Execution Sprints

We structure projects into disciplined 2-to-4 week milestone sprints with automated CI/CD deployment. You review clickable interactive prototypes and live staging previews every week—with zero surprise invoices.

EXECUTIVE PERSPECTIVE

A Letter from Our Engineering Leadership

Why we built UraanLabs with skin in the game, and why technical excellence will always come before agency bloat.

Usman Ahmed

Founder & Principal Systems Architect

VERIFIED LEADERSHIP • KARACHI HQ & GLOBAL

“When we founded UraanLabs, we made one non-negotiable rule: we will never engineer software that we wouldn't trust with our own personal capital, private data, and reputation.”

Too many founders and enterprise leaders are trapped between bloated corporate consultancies charging six-figure retainers for slide decks and low-cost freelance marketplaces delivering brittle, vulnerable code. In the AI era, this has devolved into fragile wrappers that hallucinate and leak proprietary records.

UraanLabs is the antidote. We cut out agency bureaucracy. When you partner with our studio, you collaborate directly with principal systems architects and senior engineers who obsess over deterministic data pipelines, zero-trust cloud security, and category-defining product craft.

Every commit we deploy is engineered for production scale from day zero. That is our unconditional commitment to your business.

Usman Ahmed Principal Architect & Founder, UraanLabs
Schedule Architecture Session with Usman →
OUR ENGINEERING PRINCIPLES

The Code Standards We Live By

🔑

Zero Vendor Lock-in

You own 100% of the Git repositories, Docker containers, database seeds, and Figma design tokens upon milestone completion.

💻

Deterministic Reliability

We prioritize type-safe TypeScript, resilient Python microservices, and idempotent webhook handlers over brittle shortcuts.

⚙

Strict Data Governance

We enforce Zero Data Retention agreements with model providers and offer localized VPC self-hosting for enterprise clients.

JOIN THE FLIGHT

We Are Hiring Senior Technical Craftspeople

Tired of corporate bureaucracy and junior code review loops? We're actively looking for senior full-stack engineers, AI researchers, and UI/UX product craftspeople worldwide.

HIPAA-compliant cloud storage, end-to-end payload encryption at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3).

Real Estate

High-speed interactive property portals with map-based search, instant WhatsApp lead qualification AI bots, and automated lease generation.

Logistics & Supply Chain

Vision-LLM automated BOL OCR extraction, offline-capable mobile driver companion apps, and real-time GPS telemetry backends.

Startups & SaaS

Industry Bottlenecks Solved: High developer salaries draining pre-seed runway, endless development cycles that miss launch windows, and messy codebases that fail investor technical due diligence.

DATA PRIVACY & COMPLIANCE STANDARDS

Privacy Policy

Last updated: October 2026. Data handling, corporate telemetry, and privacy commitments governing all web interactions and digital consultations with UraanLabs.

Executive Data Governance Principles

  • Zero Public AI Training: We guarantee that proprietary client datasets, private source code, and enterprise credentials are never ingested or utilized to train commercial foundation models.
  • Commercial Necessity Only: Personal and corporate data is processed strictly to provide architecture roadmaps, execute SOW contracts, and communicate regarding deliverables.
  • No Third-Party Data Monetization: UraanLabs never sells, rents, leases, or trades client inquiry data to third-party data brokers or marketing aggregators.
  • Bank-Grade Transport Security: All client communications and web interactions are guarded by TLS 1.3 encryption and automated DDoS mitigation infrastructure.

1. Information We Collect

UraanLabs collects information directly from commercial entities and authorized corporate representatives through website forms, direct email correspondence, telephone discussions, and official WhatsApp channels:

  • Corporate Contact Details: Full name, professional work email address, company title, business phone/WhatsApp number, and geographical corporate headquarters.
  • Project Scoping Specifications: Technical architecture requirements, estimated investment parameters, existing technology stack descriptions, and targeted milestone timelines.
  • Automated Telemetry & Security Logs: Internet Protocol (IP) addresses, browser user agents, referring URLs, request timestamps, and firewall telemetry collected automatically for load balancing, intrusion detection, and DDoS prevention.

2. Lawful Basis & Purpose of Processing

UraanLabs processes collected information strictly under legitimate business interests and pre-contractual commercial necessity:

  • To formulate milestone proposals, architectural estimates, resource allocations, and fixed-price Statements of Work (SOWs).
  • To communicate directly regarding ongoing sprints, code check-ins, staging preview links, and invoice settlements.
  • By submitting an inquiry or scheduling a consultation, the Client provides explicit consent for UraanLabs engineers and account leads to contact the Client via email, telephone, or official WhatsApp channels regarding their submitted project scope.

3. Zero Foundation AI Model Training Guarantee

UraanLabs maintains strict intellectual data sovereignty protocols. We explicitly warrant that no client source code, confidential database schemas, proprietary algorithms, or corporate data provided to UraanLabs will be submitted, utilized, or exposed to train, retrain, or fine-tune any public, commercial, or third-party artificial intelligence foundation models (including OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google models). All AI pipeline development for clients is deployed within isolated, single-tenant, private enterprise VPC configurations.

4. Authorized Subprocessors & Cloud Infrastructure Disclaimer

To deliver high-availability engineering services, UraanLabs contracts with tier-1, SOC2 Type II, and ISO 27001-certified global infrastructure subprocessors, including Amazon Web Services (AWS), Cloudflare (CDN/WAF), GitHub (Version Control), and Meta/WhatsApp (Instant Messaging API). While UraanLabs selects enterprise-grade vendors, UraanLabs does not control the independent uptime or operational continuity of third-party cloud infrastructure providers and disclaims liability for upstream telecommunication or third-party server interruptions.

5. Security Safeguards & Transmission Disclaimer

UraanLabs implements robust industry-standard safeguards, including TLS 1.3 encryption for web transit and AES-256 encryption for internal documentation. However, the Client acknowledges that transmission of data across the public internet can never be guaranteed as 100% impenetrable. Consequently, while UraanLabs applies rigorous protective measures, the Client transmits preliminary scoping data and documentation at its own operational risk.

6. Data Retention, Accounting Records & Deletion Rights

Commercial inquiry records, project communications, and financial transaction data are retained for as long as necessary to fulfill active contractual obligations, provide post-release warranty support, and comply with mandatory statutory corporate, tax, and accounting regulations. Commercial clients may request the review, rectification, or permanent deletion of non-essential marketing records by submitting a verified written request to info@uraanlabs.com.

7. Amendments & Policy Governance

UraanLabs reserves the right to amend, update, or modify this Privacy Policy at any time without prior individual notice by publishing the revised version on this website with an updated revision date. Continued utilization of UraanLabs' website or engineering services following any modification constitutes full acceptance of the revised terms. This policy shall be governed in accordance with applicable laws in Sindh, Pakistan.

8. Data Protection & Security Desk

For data privacy verifications, enterprise compliance inquiries, or mutual NDA executions, contact our technical desk directly:

UraanLabs Studio — Data Protection Desk

COMMERCIAL GOVERNANCE & SOW TERMS

Terms of Service

Last updated: October 2026. Standard commercial conditions governing all software engineering, AI deployment, VAPT auditing, and architecture engagements executed by UraanLabs.

Key Commercial Terms at a Glance

  • Conditional IP Assignment: Custom code and deliverables transfer to the Client strictly upon 100% receipt of cleared milestone funds. UraanLabs withholds all IP rights until full payment.
  • Scope Containment: Features or changes outside the agreed Statement of Work (SOW) require a written Change Order at architectural hourly rates ($75–$150/hr).
  • 7-Day Deemed Acceptance: Sprints and deliverables submitted for review are deemed 100% accepted if no itemized written defects are submitted within 7 calendar days.
  • Liability Cap: UraanLabs' aggregate liability for any engagement is strictly capped at the fees actually received for the specific milestone in dispute.

1. Scope of Agreement & Contractual Hierarchy

These Terms of Service ("Terms") constitute a legally binding agreement between UraanLabs ("Studio", "Agency", "we", "us") and the ordering entity ("Client", "Customer", "you"). All projects, architecture discovery calls, and software deployments are executed pursuant to a Statement of Work (SOW) or proposal. In the event of any ambiguity, the signed SOW governs milestone specifics, while these Terms govern all payments, IP retention, liability, and dispute proceedings.

2. Milestone Payments, Deposits & Stop-Work Rights

Engineering sprints and technical allocations are scheduled based on clear financial commitments:

  • Non-Refundable Onboarding Deposits: Project initiation requires an initial deposit (typically 30% to 50% of the SOW valuation). All deposits and sprint disbursements are strictly non-refundable once architectural work or engineering allocations have commenced.
  • Invoicing & Due Dates: Milestone invoices are payable upon presentation (Net-7). Any invoice unpaid after seven (7) calendar days shall accrue a compounding late finance charge of 1.5% per month (or the maximum statutory limit).
  • Immediate Stop-Work Remedy: If the Client fails to pay any milestone invoice when due, UraanLabs reserves the absolute right, without breach or liability, to immediately pause all active engineering, freeze staging environments, revoke repository commit privileges, and withhold deployment credentials until all balances are settled in full.

3. Intellectual Property Reservation & Background IP

UraanLabs maintains strict protection over its engineering outputs and proprietary tooling:

  • Retention of Title: Full title, copyright, and intellectual property in all custom code, UI designs, database schemas, and deliverables remain the exclusive property of UraanLabs until all fees, taxes, and change orders associated with the project have been paid in full with cleared funds.
  • Unauthorized Pre-Payment Use: The Client is granted zero license to deploy, compile, distribute, or commercially exploit any deliverable prior to 100% invoice settlement. Any deployment of unpaid software constitutes willful copyright infringement and an immediate breach of contract.
  • Background IP & Developer Tooling: UraanLabs retains perpetual, global, unencumbered ownership of all pre-existing design tokens, boilerplate repositories, AI agent scaffolding, CI/CD pipelines, cryptographic scripts, and architectural methodologies ("Background IP"). Upon final payment, the Client receives a perpetual, non-exclusive license to use such Background IP solely as integrated within the deliverable.

4. Scope Creep, Change Orders & 7-Day Deemed Acceptance

To ensure project momentum and protect against uncompensated scope expansion:

  • Strict Scope Boundaries: UraanLabs is obligated to build only the deliverables explicitly itemized in the approved SOW. Any extra feature, altered user flow, third-party API substitution, or design overhaul requested by the Client constitutes an out-of-scope "Change Order", billable at UraanLabs' standard architectural rate of $75 to $150 per hour or a separate fixed addendum.
  • 7-Day Deemed Acceptance: Following milestone delivery to staging or git commit check-in, the Client is granted seven (7) calendar days to perform verification. If the Client does not submit an itemized written defect notice within this 7-day period, the milestone shall be deemed irrevocably approved, accepted, and cleared for milestone disbursement.

5. Client Dependencies & Inactivity Freeze

Timely project completion depends on prompt Client collaboration. The Client agrees to deliver requested database access, third-party API credentials, domain DNS records, and design feedback within five (5) business days of request. If a project is delayed for more than ten (10) consecutive business days due to Client unresponsive conduct, UraanLabs may freeze the project, release scheduled engineering resources without penalty, and require a 15% reactivation fee to reschedule.

6. Absolute Limitation of Liability

TO THE MAXIMUM EXTENT PERMITTED BY LAW:

  • IN NO EVENT SHALL URAANLABS, ITS SENIOR ARCHITECTS, DIRECTORS, CONTRACTORS, OR AFFILIATES BE LIABLE FOR ANY CONSEQUENTIAL, INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, PUNITIVE, OR EXEMPLARY DAMAGES, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO LOSS OF PROFITS, LOSS OF REVENUE, LOSS OF BUSINESS OPPORTUNITY, LOSS OF DATA, SYSTEM DOWNTIME, OR REPUTATIONAL DAMAGE, ARISING OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THE SERVICES.
  • URAANLABS' TOTAL CUMULATIVE AGGREGATE LIABILITY FOR ALL CLAIMS OF ANY KIND (WHETHER IN CONTRACT, TORT, NEGLIGENCE, STRICT LIABILITY, OR INDEMNITY) SHALL NOT EXCEED THE TOTAL NET AMOUNT ACTUALLY RECEIVED BY URAANLABS FROM THE CLIENT FOR THE SPECIFIC MILESTONE IN DISPUTE DURING THE THIRTY (30) DAYS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE OCCURRENCE GIVING RISE TO LIABILITY.

7. Cybersecurity, Penetration Testing & VAPT Disclaimers

For cybersecurity assessments, vulnerability assessments, and penetration testing (VAPT):

  • VAPT audits and source code reviews evaluate security posture at a single point in time based on agreed scopes and publicly known vulnerability signatures. UraanLabs DOES NOT warrant that an audited application, network, or smart contract is 100% impenetrable or immune from future zero-day vulnerabilities, social engineering, credential stuffing, or subsequent code changes.
  • The Client assumes full operational responsibility for patching identified vulnerabilities. The Client agrees to indemnify, defend, and hold UraanLabs harmless against any regulatory fines, ransomware losses, or third-party lawsuits resulting from security breaches on the Client's infrastructure.

8. Limited 30-Day Bug Warranty & "As-Is" Cloud Deployments

Following final production handover, UraanLabs provides a complimentary thirty (30) day functional defect warranty strictly covering reproducible deviations from the signed SOW specifications. This warranty is voided immediately if the codebase is modified, refactored, or updated by the Client or any third-party engineer. EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY PROVIDED, ALL SERVICES, SCRIPTS, AND DELIVERABLES ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" AND "AS AVAILABLE" WITHOUT ANY IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY, FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE, OR UNINTERRUPTED AVAILABILITY.

9. Portfolio & Marketing Attribution

Unless the Client executes an explicit, paid White-Label Non-Disclosure Addendum prior to project kickoff, UraanLabs reserves the perpetual right to display non-confidential screenshots, design mockups, architectural case studies, and the Client's corporate logo in UraanLabs' promotional portfolio, social channels, and technical articles.

10. Contract Termination & Settlement

Either party may terminate an active SOW upon fourteen (14) days written notice. In the event of early termination by the Client, the Client shall immediately compensate UraanLabs for all work completed, unbilled developer hours, and milestones in progress up to the effective termination date. Under no circumstances shall previously disbursed milestone fees or deposits be subject to clawback or refund.

11. Governing Law, Exclusive Venue & Mandatory Arbitration

These Terms, all SOWs, and any commercial disputes arising from engagements with UraanLabs shall be governed exclusively by the laws of Sindh, Pakistan, without regard to conflict-of-law principles. Any controversy or dispute shall be settled exclusively through binding, confidential commercial arbitration in Karachi, Pakistan, under the Arbitration Act, 1940. Each party shall bear its own legal and representation expenses, and judgments may be entered in any court having competent jurisdiction.
